description: P19 bounded source-driven expression search. Candidate remains unapproved until existing adoption gates pass.

microtheory.name: open_process_search
microtheory.description: Enumerate typed process expressions from residual task effects and held process evidence.

rules.name: ops_request_bounded_search
rules.comment: Fund one bounded expression-search frontier from an observed stuck task.

rules.name: ops_enable_only_funded_search
rules.comment: Open expression enumeration only after shared ThinkingBudget approval.

rules.name: ops_record_compose_attempt
rules.comment: Count every bounded grammar expression attempt, including unsupported effects; recipe selection never reads a candidate name.

rules.name: ops_mint_verified_compose_candidate
rules.comment: Retain an exact candidate only when its native effect reaches the observed goal; preserve expression, guard, subgoal and source witnesses.
